title: Heterogeneous metric ensemble for quantization calibration and safety
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Deliver a modular metric-ensemble component that computes and aggregates a heterogenous set of quality signals for FP8/INT8 quantized profiles. The component will be used by the calibration pipeline to decide pass/fail for candidate profiles and to surface human-readable diagnostics for rollouts. It must support: perplexity and token-level entropy diagnostics for language-model fidelity; MMLU-style task suites with per-task pass/fail thresholds; sequence-level BLEU/ROUGE for summarization/translation checks; and pluggable task-specific scorers (e.g., QA exact match/F1, code-exec accuracy). The output is a structured score vector and a composite safety/fidelity verdict used by gating automation and the rollout dashboard.

The implementation should prioritize extensibility (new scorers can be registered), determinism in offline validation runs, and explainability (traceable mapping from failing examples to score components). We will avoid embedding full evaluation datasets; connectors will reference canonical eval buckets in the evaluation infra.
background: Current calibration pipelines produce a handful of global numbers (avg perplexity, a small set of task scores) which don't capture multi-task tradeoffs or localized failures. Teams struggle to interpret why an INT8 profile fails: is the issue perplexity drift, a single catastrophic task, or bursty decoder token error? Without richer, structured scoring and clear aggregation rules we gate out profiles that might be acceptable for many customers or accept unsafe profiles for specific tasks.
goals: Implement a scorer registry with adapters for perplexity, MMLU-style multiple-choice accuracy, BLEU, ROUGE, and standard task scorers (EM, F1, execution-based correctness).
Define a composite aggregation strategy that supports configurable weights and task-level gating rules (e.g., >X drop on critical tasks = fail).
Expose per-example diagnostics (top-K worst examples per metric) for human review within the calibration UI.
Integrate composite verdict into the calibration orchestrator so automated rollouts use the new gate.
Provide reproducible offline evaluation harness with deterministic seeds, single-run artifact outputs, and a JSON result schema consumed by the console and Canary jobs.
non_goals: Provide an exhaustive suite of datasets — we will reference existing canonical evaluation buckets instead of shipping new data.
Implement online A/B experimentation of quantized vs float models — rollout gating will be handled by separate rollout infra PRs.
Ship model re-training or quant-aware fine-tuning as part of this ticket.
success_metrics: Reduction in ambiguous calibration failures (measured by PR triage notes) by 60% within two sprints.
Composite gate catches regressions that single-metric checks missed in at least 3 prior failed rollouts (post-mortem verification).
Average time for an engineer to identify root cause of a failed calibration run reduced from ~3 hours to <30 minutes using per-example diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Scorer registry implemented and documented; at least 5 scorer adapters present (perplexity, MMLU-style, BLEU, ROUGE, EM/F1).
Composite aggregation config accepted by calibration orchestrator and switchable per-profile.
JSON result schema documented and produced by offline harness; Console ingest validated in staging.
End-to-end test: run calibration on sample FP8/INT8 candidate and produce verdict + top-10 failing examples per metric.
Performance: scorer pipeline adds <15% wall-clock time to existing calibration run for standard workloads.
implementation_plan: Design schema for scorer outputs and composite vector (fields: metric_name, value, task, example_ids, confidence).
Build scorer registry with plugin interface (register(name, compute(batch) -> MetricOutput)).
Implement core scorers (perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy adapter, BLEU, ROUGE, EM/F1). Use existing tokenizers and detokenizers from runtime SDK.
Add per-example diagnostics collector to capture worst N examples per metric with diff-style annotations for generation vs reference.
Create aggregator that applies weight maps and critical task gates; implement simple policies and a rule engine for canary thresholds.
Wire results into calibration orchestrator API and update gating decisions to consume composite verdicts.
Add unit and integration tests, plus deterministic offline evaluation job in CI that outputs artifacts to eval-bucket/staging/ENG-110999/.
Work with console team to add a staging ingestion adapter and a per-profile diagnostics view (see related link).
test_plan: Unit tests for each scorer with synthetic inputs and ground-truth outputs.
Property tests to ensure reproducibility across repeated runs with fixed RNG seeds.
Integration test: full calibration run against a small candidate model (FP8) producing composite JSON and diagnostics artifact; assertions on schema and gating decision.
Load test: run scorer pipeline against 10k-example validation shard; measure latency and memory; validate <15% overhead requirement.
Manual QA: product/ML reviewer runs the harness on historical failing profiles and confirms diagnostics identify root cause.
monitoring: Emit metrics: scorer_latency_seconds per metric, scorer_memory_bytes, composite_verdict_count{pass,fail,warn}.
Create dashboard tile for average per-metric score deltas between float and quant profiles over time.
Alert: sudden rise in composite_fail_rate > 3 sigma compared to baseline triggers on-call notification to inference-runtime SRE.
rollout_plan: Feature flag the new composite gate; start with staging-only runs for two cycles.
Run retrospective comparisons of historical calibrations with and without the new gate to validate false positive/negative rates.
Enable gate for non-critical namespaces (internal testing customers) and gather feedback for one week.
Flip gate for all calibration pipelines after sign-off from reliability and product teams.
open_questions: What default weights should we use for composite aggregation across heterogeneous tasks? (proposal: perplexity 0.3, critical-task weight 0.5, remaining tasks split).
Do we need to support streaming metric computation for very large eval shards? If so, which storage format and cursor semantics?
How will console UI display per-example diffs for proprietary datasets with redaction constraints?
risks: False-positives from composite gate due to poorly tuned weights could block usable profiles — mitigated by staged rollout and manual overrides.
Per-example diagnostics could expose PII or customer data if eval connectors are not configured correctly — mitigate via connector-level filters and redaction policy.
Performance overhead on large evaluation shards may increase calibration cost — mitigate via sampling and streaming computation fallbacks.
